description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to be used as garden room and bicycle store to front garden of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings A666/L1, 002-01, 002-03, 002-04, 002-05, 002-06, PL3/01 and PL3/M01, Photograph Sheets and Heritage Statement and Design and Access Statement, all received on 03/03/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding and cycle storage unit hereby permitted shall be as shown on the approved drawings/supporting material.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 37 Priory Avenue, W4 1TZ, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
